findings.title: Floods in Gaza leave tens of thousands without shelter
findings.location: Gaza Strip (specific building locations not enumerated)
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced Palestinian households living in tents and damaged shelters; structurally unsafe buildings and emergency-shelter supply capacity.
findings.summary: A November 8 report, citing Gaza Civil Defence, states that more than 2,000 buildings are at risk of collapse and at least 300,000 tents are needed for affected displaced people. The quantified structural-risk and shelter-requirement estimates were absent from the immediately preceding verified supplementary heartbeat and are recorded as one new-to-watch operational-risk follow-up to the already documented storm, not as a new flooding incident. Timing of original assessment and publication within the exact observation hour is unknown.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: more than 2,000 buildings are at risk of collapse and that at least 300,000 tents are needed
findings.source_type: Established news outlet reporting attributed Gaza Civil Defence estimates
